name: sf-run-club-index
description: A research-backed directory of San Francisco running clubs
author: Michael D'Angelo

scripts.generate: npm run feed && npm run csv
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && python3 scripts/validate.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && python3 scripts/build_feed.py --check && python3 scripts/build_clubs_csv.py --check && npm run test:browser
